title: Polynomial counter run
statement: Let $C,e,B\in\mathbb{N}$, let $m,o\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, let $f$ map finite bit strings to finite bit strings, let $h$ be a finite bit string, and let $v$ be a vector of fourteen natural-number registers. Suppose every register value is at most $B$, registers $6,7,10,11$ are zero, register $8$ is positive, and, with $q=e+1$ if $o$ is true and $q=e$ otherwise and $F=2C+3$ if $o$ is true and $F=C$ otherwise, both $v(8)^q$ and $Fv(8)^q$ are at most $B$. Then there is a run of the specified register program from state polynomial start with flag $o$ and register vector $v$ to tail test if $o$ is true and to length bound otherwise. Every configuration before the endpoint satisfies the program's admissibility condition and has all register values at most $B$; at the endpoint, register $7$ is $Fv(8)^q$ and every other register retains its initial value.
